name: flume
description: Find and price ceramic and porcelain floor and wall tile and vinyl flooring for projects in the US: products that look like a photo, the tiles in a room photo, alternatives to a pasted product link or a product name, shortlists, product specs, where each product can go and instant quotes to ZIP codes in the contiguous US. Price whole spec lists, finish schedules and bid packages, save products and instant quotes to Flume projects, and send pricing requests and messages to Flume's sales team.
